title: The Mouse and the Ichneumon
logline: A mongoose who has been stealing a farmer's sesame fools the wife by returning a few seeds, then talks a greedy mouse into walking under the stick in her place.
moral: The script states no moral; the picture carries it: a gift offered too easily hides a trap, and the one who never asks why can end up paying for someone else's crime.
tone: Dry, dark comedy told as a con: light and funny while the mongoose works, a held quiet beat for the mouse, a cold unsmiling exit. No gloating and no gore.

beats.summary: A poor farmer and his wife.
The physician prescribes sesame for their sick friend; the farmer buys it.
A mongoose steals the drying seeds, trip after trip.
The wife notices the loss and sits guard with a stick.
The mongoose walks into the woman's view and freezes.
She returns seeds in plain view; the wife takes her for a helper.
The mongoose looks for someone to push into the danger instead.
She invites the mouse: come and take your share.
The mouse never notices the woman sitting by the sesame.
The stick comes down; the mouse dies at once.
The wife is sure she has caught the thief.
The watching mongoose was the real thief all along.
The mongoose goes home safe; the mouse lies dead.

sets.description: The planned 'villageYard' set, built 1800 x 1230 for this film with ground at y 900. Cottage facade x 40..470 (roof line y 430, door x 300..400 from y 640, window x 110..210 at y 620..710, showing a moving silhouette). Stool at x 520. dryingMat x 600..920 on the ground. Library bush at x 1120 (w 240, h 140) as the hiding place. Burrow mound (planned 'burrow', 150 x 70) at x 1330. Library tree with trunk at x 1560 and one branch at y 520; the mouse hole (burrow at s 0.5) at its root, x 1640. Library sky, sun, hillTrees and treeRow behind; sky preset day, dusk for S16.
The planned 'hutRoom' cutaway (walls x 110..890, floor y 900) dressed as the sick friend's home: floor mattress x 600..840 with a pillow at the right, a water jug, door on the left wall.
The planned 'marketStreet' set, clear day palette, with one low stall counter x 620..820 (top y 800) holding two open sacks of white seeds and a small scale. Only 7 s of screen time: keep it simple.

props.description: Woven straw mat 320 x 26 on the ground with a heap of sesame whose size is a parameter (fill 0..1, spread 0..1); see new_assets.
The planned 'stick' (180 x 12 staff drawn from a grip point and an angle).
The planned 'sack' with fill 0..1 (small size, about 70 x 90) and the planned 'coin'.
The planned 'burrow' mound and hole, states plain and eyes in the dark; used at s 1 for the mongoose and s 0.5 for the mouse hole.

subtitles.ar: كان فلاح فقير يعيش مع زوجته، ولهما صديق مريض يحتاج إلى علاج.|أخبرهما الطبيب أن السمسم يمكن أن يساعده،|فذهب الفلاح واشترى كمية منه، ثم حملها إلى البيت.
subtitles.en: A poor farmer and his wife had a sick friend who needed treatment.|A physician told them sesame could help him,|so the farmer bought some and brought it home.

subtitles.ar: قشرت الزوجة حبوب السمسم ونشرتها حتى تجف.|وبينما كانت مشغولة بأعمال أخرى، جاءت أنثى نمس وأخذت بعض الحبوب إلى جحرها.|وعادت مرة بعد مرة، حتى نقصت الكمية كثيرًا.
subtitles.en: The wife hulled the sesame and spread it out to dry.|While she was busy, a female mongoose carried some into her burrow.|She returned repeatedly until much of the sesame was gone.

subtitles.ar: لاحظت الزوجة النقص، فجلست تراقب السمسم وفي يدها عصا.|رأت النمس تقترب من المكان.|لكن النمس كانت ذكية؛|حملت بعض الحبوب من جحرها وأعادتها أمام عيني المرأة.
subtitles.en: The wife noticed the loss and sat watching with a stick.|She saw the mongoose approach,|but it acted cleverly:|it brought some seeds from its burrow and returned them in full view of the woman.

subtitles.ar: ظنت الزوجة أن النمس لا تسرق، بل تعيد الطعام إلى مكانه.|لذلك بقيت تنتظر السارق الحقيقي.|أما النمس فذهبت تبحث عن حيوان آخر تستطيع أن تدفعه إلى الخطر بدلًا منها.
subtitles.en: The wife thought the mongoose was returning food rather than stealing it.|She waited for the real thief.|Meanwhile the mongoose looked for another animal it could send into danger in its place.

subtitles.ar: وجدت فأرة تسكن قريبًا، وقالت لها:|«هناك سمسم كثير ولذيذ، ولا يحتاج أحد إليه كله.|تعالي وخذي منه ما يكفيك، فقد أكلت أسرتي منه حتى شبعت.»
subtitles.en: It found a mouse living nearby and said,|“There is plenty of delicious sesame, more than anyone needs.|Come take your share. My family has eaten its fill.”

subtitles.ar: سمعت الفأرة الكلام فاشتهت الطعام.|لم تسأل لماذا تعرض النمس الحبوب بهذه السهولة، ولم تنتبه إلى المرأة الجالسة قرب السمسم.|أسرعت نحو الحبوب، وهي تفكر فقط في الوجبة التي تنتظرها.
subtitles.en: The mouse desired the food.|It did not ask why the mongoose offered it so freely or notice the woman sitting beside the sesame.|It hurried toward the seeds, thinking only of the meal ahead.

subtitles.ar: ما إن وصلت الفأرة إلى الطعام حتى رفعت المرأة عصاها وضربتها على رأسها.|ماتت الفأرة في الحال.|رأت الزوجة ما حدث، وظنت أنها أمسكت بالحيوان الذي كان يأخذ السمسم منذ البداية.
subtitles.en: As soon as the mouse reached the food, the woman raised her stick and struck its head.|The mouse died immediately.|The wife believed she had caught the animal stealing the sesame all along.

subtitles.ar: أما النمس فبقيت بعيدة تراقب المشهد.|كانت هي التي سرقت أكثر الحبوب، لكنها نجت لأنها جعلت الفأرة تبدو مذنبة.|وانتهت القصة بموت الفأرة، بينما عادت النمس إلى جحرها سالمة.
subtitles.en: The mongoose watched from a distance.|It had stolen most of the seeds but escaped by making the mouse appear guilty.|The mouse was dead, while the mongoose returned safely to its burrow.

new_assets.name: mongoose
new_assets.description: Long low small carnivore for this film and any later mongoose, weasel, ferret or marten (palette option). At s 1: feet at (x, y), body a rounded bar 230 long x 70 high with its top 95 above the ground, four short legs 30 long, head 80 x 60 with a pointed snout, round ears r 14, thick tapering tail 170 long. Pose fields: ph, amp (walk), rear 0..1 (pivot upright about the hind feet to about 75 degrees, forepaws tucked: the sentinel pose), sit, sniff (nose up, whisker twitch), cheeks 0..1 (stuffed cheek pouches), raise 0..1 (near forepaw up for pointing, beckoning, waving), talk, mouth (closed, smile, smirk, o, open), brow, ears -1..1, tailUp 0..1, lashes, pal, plus the shared acting fields.
new_assets.implementation: One function in Library/cast following the fox file: body as a K rounded path with the style's red or black dot shading, legs from the same walk() phase as the fox, head as a rotated group so headRot and sniff work, eyes through eye2/EYE so gaze, lid and wet work, tail as a tapered quadratic stroke with a swing() follow-through. rear is a rotation of body, head and forelegs about the hind feet. cheeks scales two cream circles at the jaw. Wrap with acting() in registry.js.

new_assets.name: rat
new_assets.description: The planned 'rat' used as a mouse: palette pal 1 (light grey, pink ears 1.3x), s 0.75. Fields used: ph, amp, sit, sniff, chew, roll (on its back), bib, tailCurl, eyes 'x', plus the shared acting fields.
new_assets.implementation: As planned by KD-011 and KD-014; add only the palette entry and an ear size factor. If the rat is not built yet, build it once here from an egg-shaped body 110 x 70, a 60 x 50 head, two ear discs, four short legs on walk() and a tail drawn as a quadratic stroke.

new_assets.name: dryingMat
new_assets.description: A straw mat 320 x 26 (yellow with brown weave lines and a fringe at both ends) carrying a heap of grain. Fields: fill 0..1 (heap height up to 60 and width up to 260; at 0.35 bare mat shows at both sides), spread 0..1 (seeds fan out from one end), jump (px, for the hit), colour (white sesame by default, so it can be wheat, rice or dates later). 40 seeded loose seeds around the heap edge.
new_assets.implementation: Mat: K rounded rect plus short strokes. Heap: a flattened ellipse cap in white with blue Ben-Day dots on the shaded side and small black seed ticks placed by K.rng with a fixed seed; fill scales the cap. Also reused inside the picture balloon, the thought clouds and the ground window.

owner_questions: The strike on the mouse is hidden by a white flash and a THWACK! star burst, and the dead mouse is shown whole on her back with X eyes and no blood; default: softened as described.
The contact of the stick is placed at 135.20 in the pause after the sentence, so the thud never covers a word; default: accepted, although the hit lands about 2 s after the word for struck.
Two small gags not in the script are added while the mongoose searches (a bird flies off, a Library tortoise hides in its shell); default: kept, total 1.4 s.
English lettering added: SESAME, DOCTOR, MONGOOSE, MOUSE, STICK, SNIFF!, HMM?, LESS!, HELPER!, PSST!, YUM!, DANGER, THWACK!, GOT YOU!, REAL THIEF, GUILTY?; default: kept (16 words in 171 s).
The script gives no moral line, so no moral caption is shown and the film ends on the mongoose going home; default: THE END only.
The mongoose is drawn with eyelashes to show she is female as the script says; default: kept.
implementation_notes: One world for S1 and S4 to S16: villageYard 1800 x 1230, ground y 900. Bake the back layers once per sky preset (day, dusk) and cross-fade the two bakes during 162.86 to 164.4.
Set LIFE.t = t each frame so every character blinks; give explicit lid where a scene asks for stillness, a stare (noBlink) or a slow blink.

Drive every traverse with a position function and walk() and footfalls(): the three theft trips (S5) share one keyed X list [mat 880, burrow 1330] so the counter, the mat fill and the dust all come from the same keys.

dryingMat fill timeline: 0 before 23.8; spread to 1.0 by 24.8; 0.8 at 34.9; 0.6 at 37.3; 0.35 at 38.9 and held; 0.40 from 61.6; unchanged to the end. The low heap must stay visibly low in S14 so the wife's pride reads as a mistake.
The wife sits on the stool from 45.56 to 130.98 without a break; keep her alive in every wide shot with blinks, gaze plans and small stick moves, even when she is tiny.
Mask on, mask off: the mongoose smirks only when no other character can see her face (62.82, 74.94, 103.30). Keep those smirks 6 to 10 frames.

The strike: gap at rest, lift at 130.98, wind-up at 133.02, whip down from 134.95, contact 135.20, damped rebound with no second contact (the Fox strike cycle). Flash 2 frames. Shake inside the panel clip only.
Hiding in the bush and entering the burrows: draw the actor first and the occluder after it, or clip at the hole edge; no second clipped copy.
Thought clouds and balloons sit above y 560 in world terms and never cover a face, except the deliberate case at 118.82 where the mouse's cloud covers the woman.
Sound: nine quiet effects, all in listed pauses or after the last word: pop 4.1, pop 8.8, whoosh 20.2, pop 85.2, chime 104.7, pop 110.0, whoosh 126.6, thud 135.25, chime 170.9. SND master 0.6.

Cue times are word starts from timeline.md; starts after a pause can include a little silence, so check the onsets at 20.82, 85.76, 105.36, 110.56, 127.19 and 136.06 against the audio envelope before locking those actions.
Subtitle chunks are in the subtitles array (3 chunks per paragraph, 4 for paragraph 3), verbatim from story/script.json.
warnings: Many assets this film relies on are planned by other stories but not yet in Library (rat, villager variants, physician and merchant presets, sit, kneel and lie poses, villageYard, hutRoom, marketStreet, thoughtCloud, iconBalloon, groundWindow, inset circle, stick, sack, burrow). If AN-039 is animated before them, it must build them; the only assets new to the whole plan are mongoose and dryingMat.
The mongoose and the mouse are small (about 95 and 55 units high). Use zoom 1.4 or more whenever they act alone, and keep faces at least 110 px on screen.
S1 to S3 use three sets in 20 s for the first paragraph. If time is short, S3 can be staged in the yard with the seller's stall as an inset circle.
The death of the mouse must stay calm and clear, never funny after the hit: no stars circling, no comic bounce after 136.06.
Three mongoose thefts, one replay in the wife's cloud and one in the inset use the same motion; write it once as a function of a local clock.
